_note: C-33 trailer / donor chassis / machine parameters. DATA, not code. Additive; separate from scoring-config.json and auction-model.json. REC values; not Michael-confirmed.

cash_cap_per_buy.note: owner cap per buy (C-24 / C-32 intake); over-cap deals cannot be YES

estimate_haircut.note: parts valued by estimate (not sold/scrap evidence) count at this share in the expected case and never in the floor

as_is_resale_factor.note: as-is resale of a no-title or bill-of-sale trailer as a share of the resolved resale, unless the input gives its own

forecast.note: heuristic, not observed: uplift = time_coeff * min(hours_left, horizon)/horizon * (1 + bid_coeff * min(bid_count, bid_cap))
